crossRefs.note: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.
Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.

translations.web: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.
translations.bsb: Whoever conceals an offense promotes love, but he who brings it up separates friends.
translations.kjv: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.
translations.asv: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; But he that harpeth on a matter separateth chief friends.
